DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: カードについてのお困りごとですね。どのような状況ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're having trouble with your card. What's happened?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 昨日使ったキャッシュカードが財布にありません。自宅にあるかもしれませんが、先に利用を止めたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 昨日使用したカードが財布になく自宅の可能性はあっても停止を希望すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: The cash card I used yesterday isn't in my wallet. It might be at home, but I'd like to stop its use first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say yesterday's card isn't in your wallet and you want it blocked even though it may be at home. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 紛失の担当へすぐおつなぎします。カードの番号以外で確認できる情報はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll connect you to the lost-card staff immediately. Do you have information we can check other than the card number?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 口座の通帳と本人確認書類を持っています。これで確認してもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 通帳と本人確認書類を持参しそれで照合できるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have my bankbook and identification. Can you check using these?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you brought your bankbook and identification and ask whether they can be used for verification. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 担当が拝見して確認します。暗証番号をここで口にする必要はありません。停止後の手続きも相談されますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: The staff member will look at them and check. You don't need to say your PIN aloud here. Would you also like advice about procedures after blocking?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 停止は先にお願いします。そのあと、カードの再発行に必要な物と費用を聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 利用停止を先に頼みその後再発行の必要物と費用を聞きたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please block it first. After that, I'd like to ask what I need for a replacement card and the cost.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask for blocking first, then say you want to know replacement requirements and fees. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その順で担当へお伝えします。再発行の条件は確認を受けてください。ほかに心配な点はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll tell the staff member that order. Please have the replacement conditions checked. Is there anything else worrying you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 帰宅してカードが見つかったら、すぐに使えるのでしょうか。それとも銀行へ連絡が必要ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 帰宅後カードが見つかった場合の利用と銀行への連絡を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: If I find the card when I get home, can I use it straight away, or do I need to contact the bank?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask about using the card and contacting the bank if you find it after returning home. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 見つかっても、そのまま使えると考えず、担当に対応方法を確認してください。停止の手続きをした後の扱いも一緒に聞けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Even if you find it, don't assume it can be used as it is; ask the staff member what to do. You can also ask how it's handled after blocking.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 見つかったときの連絡方法も聞きます。まず通帳と本人確認書類を担当者に見せて、利用停止を頼みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 発見時の連絡方法も確認し書類を担当へ示して停止を頼むと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll ask how to contact you if I find it too. First, I'll show my bankbook and identification to the staff member and ask for blocking.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you'll also check how to report finding it, show the staff your documents and request blocking. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 担当窓口はこちらです。書類をお持ちになってお進みください。それでは、私はここで失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: The relevant counter is here. Please take your documents and go ahead. I'll leave you here now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 袋から商品を出す前に、ご相談の内容を伺えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Before taking the product out of the bag, may I ask what you'd like to discuss?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 昨日買った洗剤の容器から液が漏れています。棚に置いていたら、下が濡れていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 昨日購入した洗剤が棚で液漏れしたと報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Liquid is leaking from the detergent container I bought yesterday. I had it on a shelf and found it wet underneath.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report that yesterday's detergent purchase leaked on the shelf. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 袋はそのままこちらのトレーへ置いてください。ふたを開けたり、中身を使ったりしましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Place the bag as it is on this tray. Have you opened the lid or used the contents?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: どちらもしていません。買ったまま立てて置いていましたが、容器の横に細い割れ目が見えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未開封未使用で立てて保管し容器横の割れ目を見つけたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Neither. I kept it upright as bought, but can see a thin crack in the side of the container.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain it's unopened and unused, was stored upright, and you found a crack in its side. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 状態を確認します。購入した商品か照合するため、レシートも見せていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll check its condition. May I see the receipt too, to verify it's the product you bought?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: これが昨日のレシートです。洗剤はこの行で、支払いにはカードを使いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 昨日のレシートの該当行とカード払いを示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: This is yesterday's receipt. The detergent is this line, and I paid by card.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show yesterday's receipt's relevant line and state that you paid by card. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 確認できました。対応は担当者と確認します。交換を希望されますか、それとも別の対応をご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: I've confirmed it. I'll check with the person responsible about handling this. Would you like an exchange or another solution?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 同じ洗剤を使いたいので、液が漏れていない物への交換を希望します。対応できるか教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 漏れのない同じ洗剤への交換を希望し対応可能か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'd like to use the same detergent, so I want an exchange for one that isn't leaking. Please tell me whether that's possible.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Request the same detergent without a leak and ask whether an exchange is possible. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当へ交換の希望を伝えます。確認中はこちらで容器をお預かりしますので、無理に触らずお待ちいただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll pass on your exchange request. We'll hold the container while checking, so could you wait without trying to handle it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 容器を預けて、ここで待ちます。確認が終わったら交換の可否を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 容器を店に預けて待ち交換可否の回答を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll leave the container with you and wait here. Once you've checked, please tell me whether an exchange is possible.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Leave the container with the shop and wait, asking for an answer about the exchange. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承りました。担当を呼んできますので、少々お待ちください。それでは一度失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I'll call the person responsible, so please wait a little. Excuse me for a moment.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 園内を歩かれますか。案内図で今いる入口をお示ししますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Will you be walking in the park? I'll show this entrance where we are on the map.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 久しぶりの散歩なので、十五分くらいで戻れる道を教えてください。急な坂は避けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 久しぶりなので十五分程度で戻れる急坂のない散歩道を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: It's my first walk in a while, so please tell me a route I can return from in about fifteen minutes. I'd like to avoid steep slopes.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for a walk without steep slopes that takes about fifteen minutes to return, since it's been a while. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらの平らな道を、花壇の前で引き返す方法があります。一周する必要はありません。速さによって時間は変わります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: One option is this level path, turning back in front of the flowerbed. You don't need to make a circuit. The time varies with your speed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 花壇まで行く途中で疲れたら、座って休める場所はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 花壇への途中で疲れた場合の座れる休憩場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: If I get tired on the way to the flowerbed, is there somewhere to sit and rest?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask for a seated resting spot if you get tired on the way to the flowerbed. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 道の左側にベンチがあります。満席なら、無理に先へ進まず、入口へ引き返しても大丈夫です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: There's a bench on the left of the path. If it's full, don't force yourself onward; it's fine to turn back to the entrance.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ベンチの所で引き返した場合も、この入口に戻れますか。分かれ道で迷いそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: ベンチで引き返して同じ入口へ戻れるか尋ね迷いやすいと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: If I turn back at the bench, can I return to this entrance too? I might get lost at the fork.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask whether turning back at the bench leads to the same entrance and explain you may lose your way. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 来た道を戻ればこの入口です。分かれ道の青い案内板で、入口の矢印を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Retracing your route brings you to this entrance. At the blue sign at the fork, check the arrow for the entrance.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 青い案内板を目印にします。足元に落ち葉が多い場所は、避けた方がよいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 青い案内板を目印にすると伝え落ち葉の多い場所を避けるべきか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll use the blue sign as a landmark. Should I avoid places with lots of fallen leaves underfoot?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you'll use the blue sign as a landmark and ask whether to avoid places with many fallen leaves. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 濡れた落ち葉には注意してください。歩きにくければ、そこを無理に通らず戻ってください。入口近くにも休める場所があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Be careful of wet leaves. If walking is difficult, turn back rather than force yourself through. There's somewhere to rest near the entrance too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: まずベンチまで歩き、疲れたら花壇へは行かず戻ります。帰りは青い案内板の入口の矢印を見ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: ベンチから先へ無理に進まず疲れたら戻り青い案内板で入口を確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll walk to the bench first, and if I'm tired, return without going to the flowerbed. On the way back I'll look for the entrance arrow on the blue sign.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you won't push beyond the bench if tired, will return and check the blue sign for the entrance. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご自分のペースでどうぞ。短い散歩も楽しめるといいですね。それでは、いってらっしゃい。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34209-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Go at your own pace. I hope you enjoy even a short walk. Off you go.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 切符のご購入ですね。どちらの駅までお出かけですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: You'd like to buy a ticket. Which station are you going to?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 親戚の家へ行くので、この紙に書いた駅までお願いします。帰る日はまだ決まっていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 紙に書いた親戚宅の最寄り駅への切符を求め帰る日が未定だと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm going to a relative's home, so a ticket to the station written on this paper, please. I haven't decided when to return.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for a ticket to the written station nearest your relative's home and say your return date is undecided. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 行き先は確認できました。今回は行きの片道だけにしますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: I've confirmed the destination. Would you like just a one-way outward ticket this time?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 片道にします。向こうで帰る日を決めてから、帰りの切符を買いたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 今回は片道だけ購入し帰る日が決まってから帰路の切符を買うと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: One way, please. I'd like to buy the return ticket after deciding there when to come back.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Answer that you'll buy one way now and the return ticket after deciding your return date. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 承知しました。今日はお一人で、ご出発も本日でよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Understood. You're traveling alone today, and departing today as well, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい、一人で今日出発します。この駅名の読み方も教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 一人で今日出発することを答え行き先の駅名の読み方を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes, alone and leaving today. Please also tell me how to pronounce this station name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm traveling alone and departing today, and ask how to read the destination station's name. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 紙には「あおば」と書かれていますね。切符にもこの行き先を印字します。発券前に金額をこちらでご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: The paper says “Aoba.” This destination will be printed on your ticket too. Before issuing it, please check the amount here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この金額ですね。現金で払いますので、お釣りは小銭入れに入れるまで待っていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 提示額を確認し現金払いで釣銭をしまう間待ってほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: This amount, right? I'll pay cash, so could you wait until I've put the change in my coin purse?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check the displayed amount, say you'll pay cash and ask them to wait while you put the change away. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: どうぞゆっくりおしまいください。こちらが本日分の片道切符です。行き先をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Take your time putting it away. Here's your one-way ticket for today. Please check the destination.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 「あおば」までの片道ですね。確認しました。切符は財布と分けて、すぐ出せる所にしまいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: あおば行きの片道切符を確認し財布と別に保管すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: One way to Aoba, right? I've checked. I'll keep the ticket apart from my wallet, somewhere I can get it out quickly.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check the one-way Aoba ticket and say you'll store it separately from your wallet. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お忘れ物に気をつけて、ご乗車ください。いってらっしゃいませ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Take care not to leave anything behind when boarding. Have a good trip.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 通知についてのご相談と伺いました。まず封筒の宛名を一緒に確認してもよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: I understand you have a question about a notice. May we first check the name and address on the envelope together?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 住所が自分の家なので開けてしまいましたが、名前は私ではありません。前に住んでいた人かもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 住所は自宅だが別人宛てと知らず開封したことを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I opened it because the address is my home, but the name isn't mine. It may be the previous resident.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you opened mail addressed to someone else without realizing, because the address was yours. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 宛名がご本人ではないのですね。中に書いてある個人情報は読み上げず、封筒の差出部署を見せてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: So the addressee isn't you. Don't read the personal information inside aloud; show me the sending department on the envelope.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ここに住宅担当とあります。この窓口で預かってもらうことはできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 差出部署が住宅担当だと伝えこの窓口で預かれるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: It says housing department here. Can this counter take it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say the sender is housing and ask whether this counter can hold it. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 今、住宅担当に確認しました。担当窓口で現物を確認するとのことです。中身はすべて残っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: I've just checked with housing. They say they'll inspect the actual items at their counter. Is everything inside still there?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい、入っていた二枚をそのまま戻しました。開けてしまったことも伝えた方がいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 中の二枚を戻したことを伝え誤開封も報告するべきか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes, I put both enclosed sheets back as they were. Should I also tell them I opened it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you put both sheets back and ask whether to report the mistaken opening too. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その経緯もお伝えください。ご自分の判断で捨てたり、宛名を書き換えたりせず、担当へお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please explain that too. Don't discard it or rewrite the addressee on your own; take it to the staff responsible.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 封筒は破れています。中身が落ちないよう別の袋に入れて持っていきます。住宅担当はどこですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 破れた封筒を別袋に入れて持参すると伝え担当の場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: The envelope is torn. I'll put it in another bag to keep the contents from falling out. Where is housing?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you'll bring the torn envelope in another bag and ask where the responsible department is. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: このフロアの青い表示がある窓口です。別の袋は構いませんので、元の封筒も一緒に渡してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: It's the counter with the blue sign on this floor. Another bag is fine; hand over the original envelope too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 元の封筒と二枚の書類をまとめて、誤って開けたと説明します。青い表示の窓口へ行きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 元の封筒と二枚を渡し誤開封を説明して青い表示へ向かうと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll keep the original envelope and both documents together and explain I opened it by mistake. I'll go to the counter with the blue sign.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm you'll give the original envelope and two sheets, explain the mistaken opening and head for the blue sign. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 担当へ相談内容を伝えておきました。お気をつけてお進みください。それでは失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: I've told the department what you're asking about. Take care as you go. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 初めての受診ですね。今、体のどの部分がつらいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: This is your first visit. What part of your body is troubling you now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 今朝、階段を下りたときに左の膝が痛くなりました。転んではいません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 今朝階段を下りたとき左膝が痛くなり転倒はしていないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: My left knee started hurting when I went down the stairs this morning. I didn't fall.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain your left knee began hurting going downstairs this morning and you didn't fall. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 階段で痛みが出たのですね。今は立ったり歩いたりできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: The pain started on the stairs. Can you stand or walk now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ゆっくりなら歩けますが、膝を曲げると痛みます。長く立つのはつらいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: ゆっくり歩けるが曲げると痛く長く立てないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I can walk slowly, but bending my knee hurts. Standing for long is difficult.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Answer that you can walk slowly but bending hurts and you can't stand for long. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ここで座ってお待ちください。診察の担当を確認します。普段飲んでいる薬や、薬で具合が悪くなった経験はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Sit here and wait. I'll check who will examine you. Do you take regular medicine, or have you ever felt unwell from medicine?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 毎朝飲む薬があります。名前を覚えていないので、お薬手帳を見てもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 毎朝の薬の名前を覚えていないためお薬手帳での確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I take medicine every morning. I don't remember its name, so could you check my medicine record book?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask for a check of your medicine record book because you don't remember your morning medicine's name. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お預かりして確認し、医師に伝えます。診察室への移動が心配なら車椅子もお使いいただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll hold it, check and tell the doctor. You can use a wheelchair too if you're worried about getting to the examination room.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 診察室までは車椅子でお願いします。乗り移るときだけ手を貸してもらいたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 車椅子での移動と乗り移るときの介助を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: A wheelchair to the examination room, please. I'd only like help when transferring into it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Request a wheelchair for moving and assistance when transferring. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 私がお手伝いしますので、まだ立たずにお待ちください。痛みが強くなるなど変化があればすぐお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll help, so wait without standing up yet. Tell us immediately if anything changes, such as the pain worsening.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 座ったまま待ちます。痛みが強くなったら、我慢せず看護師さんを呼びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 座って待ち痛みが強まれば我慢せず看護師を呼ぶと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll stay seated and wait. If the pain worsens, I'll call a nurse rather than endure it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm you'll wait seated and call a nurse without enduring worsening pain. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 担当が来たら診察室へご案内します。お薬手帳も診察後にお返しします。それでは、いったん失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: When the staff member arrives, we'll take you to the examination room. We'll return the medicine book after the examination too. Excuse me for now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 拾得物を届けに来られたのですね。どのような物でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: You've come to hand in found property. What kind of item is it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 鍵が三本付いた鍵束です。公園へ続く遊歩道で拾いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 公園へ続く遊歩道で鍵三本の鍵束を拾ったと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: A set of three keys. I found them on the walking path leading to the park.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you found a set of three keys on the path leading to the park. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お預かりします。遊歩道のどの辺りで、いつ見つけましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: We'll take them. Where on the path did you find them, and when?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 今日の午後二時ごろです。小さな橋を渡った先のベンチの下にありました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 今日午後二時ごろ橋の先のベンチ下で見つけたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Around two this afternoon. They were under the bench just beyond the small bridge.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain you found them around two this afternoon beneath a bench beyond the bridge. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その場所をこちらの地図で示していただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Could you indicate the spot on this map?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この橋の東側です。ベンチが二つ並んでいて、そのうち川に近い方の下でした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 地図で橋の東側の川に近いベンチ下を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: East of this bridge. Two benches are side by side, and they were under the one closer to the river.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the spot east of the bridge beneath the bench nearer the river on the map. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 地点を記録しました。鍵束は見つけたときのままですか。何か外した物はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: I've recorded the spot. Are the keys as you found them? Have you removed anything?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 何も外していません。赤いひもも付いたままで、袋に入れてここへ持ってきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 赤いひもを含め何も外さず袋に入れて運んだと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I haven't removed anything. The red cord is still attached; I put them in a bag and brought them here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Answer that you removed nothing, including the red cord, and brought them in a bag. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。この後の手続きと連絡についてご説明します。記録の控えをお渡しするので、内容をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Thank you. I'll explain the subsequent procedures and contact arrangements. I'll give you a copy of the record; please check its contents.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 日時と場所は合っています。手続きの説明を聞いてから記入しますので、連絡先を書く欄を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 控えの日時場所を確認し説明後の記入を希望して連絡先欄を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: The date, time and place are correct. I'll fill it in after hearing the procedure explained, so show me where to write my contact details.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check the copy's date, time and place, ask to fill in after the explanation and ask for the contact section. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらの欄です。説明の後に一緒に確認しましょう。お届けいただきありがとうございました。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: This section here. Let's check it together after the explanation. Thank you for bringing them in. Take care going home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 転居後の郵便についてですね。お持ちの封筒はご本人宛てですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: This is about mail after moving. Is the envelope you brought addressed to you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 妻宛てです。私も一緒に引っ越しましたが、私の手紙はまだ旧住所へ届いているようです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 妻の手紙は転送されたが自分の手紙は旧住所に届く状況を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: It's for my wife. I moved with her, but my own letters seem still to be arriving at the old address.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say your wife's mail was forwarded but your own still arrives at the old address. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 転居のお届けに、ご本人のお名前も記載されているか確認しましょう。お届けの控えはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's check whether your name is included in the moving notification. Do you have a copy of the notification?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 妻が手続きしたので、控えは持っていません。この転送された封筒だけではわかりませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 妻が手続きし控えを持っていないと説明し転送済み封筒で確認できるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: My wife handled it, so I haven't brought a copy. Can't you tell from this forwarded envelope alone?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain your wife handled it and you don't have the copy, then ask whether the forwarded envelope can confirm it. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この封筒からは奥様の郵便が転送されたことしか確認できません。お届け内容の照会には別の確認が必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: This envelope only confirms that your wife's mail was forwarded. Checking the notification's contents requires separate verification.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では、確認に必要なものを教えてください。妻と一緒に来た方がいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 照会に必要な持ち物と妻の同行の必要性を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then tell me what I need for checking. Would it be better to come with my wife?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask what to bring for the inquiry and whether your wife needs to accompany you. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: まずお届け方法と本人確認について伺ってからご案内します。奥様がどのように届け出たか、ご自宅で確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: First I'll ask about the notification method and identity verification, then guide you. Can you check at home how your wife filed it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今夜、妻に控えがあるか聞きます。私の名前が入っていなければ追加の手続きを相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 今夜妻に控えを確認し自分の名前がなければ追加手続きを相談すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Tonight I'll ask my wife whether she has a copy. If my name isn't included, I'd like advice about adding it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you'll check the copy with your wife tonight and ask about additional procedures if your name isn't included. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、届出の内容を確認してから、必要な手続きをご案内します。送り主への住所変更の連絡も進めてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, after checking the notification's details we'll explain the required procedure. Please also notify senders of your address change.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 会社と知人には新住所を知らせます。妻に届出の内容を確認してから、もう一度相談に来ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 会社と知人へ新住所を通知し届出内容を確認後に再相談すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll tell my company and acquaintances the new address. I'll check the notification details with my wife, then come for advice again.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you'll notify your company and acquaintances of the new address and return after checking the notification details. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その際は確認できた内容をお知らせください。本日はありがとうございました。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: When you return, tell us what you've confirmed. Thank you for coming today. Take care going home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 登録住所の変更についてですね。もうお引越しはお済みですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: This is about changing your registered address. Have you already moved?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 来月引っ越す予定です。銀行の郵便だけ、先に新しい家へ送ってもらいたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 来月転居予定で銀行郵便を先に新居へ送りたいと希望を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I plan to move next month. I'd like just my bank mail sent to the new home beforehand.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you're moving next month and want bank mail sent to your new home in advance. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 新しい家で、現在郵便物を受け取れる方はいらっしゃいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Is there anyone at the new home who can receive mail now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだ鍵を受け取っていません。今の住人が住んでいるので、私には受け取れません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 鍵を受け取っておらず現住人がいるため新居で受領できないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I haven't received the keys yet. The current resident is still living there, so I can't receive it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain you don't have the keys and can't receive mail at the new home because the current resident is there. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: それですと先に送付先を変えるのは心配ですね。転居後の届出について、ご準備いただくものを確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Then changing the mailing destination early would be concerning. Let's check what to prepare for notifying us after your move.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 実際に住み始めてから変更します。それまでの郵便は今の住所に届くままでいいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 転居後に変更しそれまで現住所への郵送を維持したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll change it after actually starting to live there. Until then, mail can keep coming to my current address.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you'll change it after moving and want mail to continue at your current address until then. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 本日は変更を行わず、登録はそのままにします。新住所が確認できる書類を用意できる時期はわかりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: We won't make a change today; the registration stays as it is. Do you know when you can prepare documents confirming your new address?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 引っ越した後に書類の住所を更新する予定です。どの書類が使えるか一覧をください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 転居後に書類住所を更新する予定を伝え使用可能な書類一覧を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I plan to update my documents' address after moving. Please give me a list of which documents are acceptable.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you'll update document addresses after moving and request a list of acceptable documents. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 当行の手続き案内をお渡しします。変更時には一覧の条件を確認し、わからない書類は窓口へお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll give you our bank's procedure guide. When changing it, check the list's conditions and bring any documents you're unsure about to the counter.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今の住所の登録は残し、転居と書類の更新が済んでから手続きします。今日は案内だけ受け取ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 現登録を維持し転居と書類更新後に変更すると確認して案内だけ受け取る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll keep the current address registered and apply after moving and updating the documents. Today I'll just take the guide.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm keeping the current registration and changing after moving and updating documents, taking only the guide today. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。新居の住所を他の方のものと取り違えないようご確認ください。ありがとうございました。さようなら。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Check that you haven't confused your new address with someone else's. Thank you. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 冷凍食品の売り場でお探しでしょうか。何かお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for something in frozen foods? Can I help?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この冷凍うどんを買いたいのですが、家まで歩いて四十分かかります。保冷袋はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 冷凍うどん購入希望と徒歩四十分の帰路を伝え保冷袋を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like this frozen udon, but it's a forty-minute walk home. Do you have insulated bags?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want frozen udon and have a forty-minute walk home, and ask for an insulated bag. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 売り場を確認しましたが、今日は保冷袋が売り切れています。保冷剤もご用意できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: I've checked the department, but insulated bags are sold out today. We can't provide ice packs either.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 普通の買い物袋しか持っていません。袋の裏にある保存方法を一緒に見てもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 普通の袋しかないことを伝え保存表示の確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I only have an ordinary shopping bag. Could you look at the storage instructions on the back of the package with me?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you only have a normal bag and ask to check the storage label together. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらに冷凍で保存するよう書いてあります。普通の袋でどれくらい冷たいまま運べるかは、お約束できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: It says here to store frozen. We can't promise how long it will stay cold in an ordinary bag.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 途中で解けても、家でもう一度凍らせればいいという意味ではないですよね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 解けても再冷凍すればよいという意味ではないか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: That doesn't mean it's okay to freeze it again at home even if it thaws on the way, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check that this doesn't mean thawed food can simply be refrozen. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ええ、この表示は持ち帰り中に解けた場合の扱いを保証するものではありません。心配でしたら今回は別の商品をお選びください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Right. This label doesn't guarantee how to handle it if it thaws on the way home. If you're concerned, choose something else this time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: では冷凍うどんは戻します。常温で保存できる乾麺はどこにありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 冷凍うどんを戻すと伝え常温保存できる乾麺の場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then I'll put the frozen udon back. Where are dry noodles that can be stored at room temperature?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you'll put the frozen udon back and ask for room-temperature dry noodles. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 三番の棚にあります。乾麺でも商品ごとの保存表示を確認してお選びください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: On shelf three. Even with dry noodles, check each product's storage label when choosing.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 三番の棚で乾麺を探します。今日は冷凍食品を買わず、次は保冷袋を持ってきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 三番棚で乾麺を探し今回は冷凍品を買わず次回保冷袋を持参すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll look for dry noodles on shelf three. I won't buy frozen food today, and next time I'll bring an insulated bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to find dry noodles on shelf three, skip frozen food this time and bring an insulated bag next time. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 冷凍うどんはこちらでお戻しします。ほかにも必要でしたらお声がけください。ありがとうございました。またお越しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: We'll put the frozen udon back. Let us know if you need anything else. Thank you. Please come again.
